description: If \(H_L\ne\varnothing\), a set of universally asserted relation clauses has no model exactly when a finite subset of its ground clauses has a refutation in the existing shared propositional resolution calculus.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.finite_ground_refutation.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  [Nonempty (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundTerm L)]
  (Γ : Set (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.FOClause L α)) :
  ¬Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.ClauseSatisfiable Γ ↔
    ∃ Δ,
      ↑Δ ⊆ Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.GroundClauses Γ ∧ Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Derives Δ ∅
